title: layr status --json
description: The state of the working folder of the current line, compared with the line head. Paths are relative to the line root and use '/'. Path arguments of the command filter every list except 'overlaps'.

line.description: The name of the current line.

line_id.description: The id of the current line. It stays the same when the line is renamed.

head.description: The id of the state at the head of the line.

staged.description: Changes that 'layr add' or 'layr rm' marked for the next save.

unstaged.description: Changes in the working folder that are not marked for the next save.

untracked.description: Files that the line does not track and that no ignore rule matches.

ignored.description: Files that an ignore rule matches. Absent with --no-ignored.

conflicts.description: Paths with an open merge conflict. Empty when the head has no conflicts.

overlaps.description: Paths that this line and another live line both changed. Absent with --no-overlaps. Empty for a virtual line or a filtered view.

id.description: A layr id (a state, line, change or machine) in UUID form.

path.description: The path of the file after the change.

old_path.description: The path before a rename. Null when the file did not move.

status.description: The kind of change, as in git: A added, D deleted, M modified, R renamed, T type changed (for example a file became a link).

conflict.description: One path with an open merge conflict.

base.description: The id of the merge base state. Absent when there is none.

ours.description: The id of the state of this line in the merge.

theirs.description: The id of the state that was merged in.

overlap.description: A path that another live line also changed.

path.description: The path that both lines changed.

line.description: The name of the other line.

owner.description: The user id (uid) of the owner of the other line.

changed_at.description: When the other line changed the path, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
